Metadata.title: Skillwave Academy — online school of digital professions
Metadata.description: Courses in frontend development, UX/UI design, Python, data analytics and digital marketing. Our assistant answers your questions about courses 24/7.

hero.title: A digital profession from scratch — with a mentor, real projects and job support
hero.subtitle: Five online courses for beginners in development, design, analytics and marketing. Our assistant answers questions about programs, prices and installments right now.
hero.chatQuestion: How much is the Python Developer course, and can I pay in installments?
hero.chatAnswer: The course costs **95,000 RUB**, or 85,500 RUB if you pay in full. Interest-free installments for 12 months start at **7,917 RUB per month**.

courses.title: Courses
courses.subtitle: Online learning: recorded lessons, live webinars twice a week and mentor-reviewed assignments. Classes are taught in Russian.
courses.askPrompt: Tell me more about the {course} course
courses.projects: {count, plural, one {# portfolio project} other {# portfolio projects}}

frontend.name: Frontend Developer
frontend.description: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React and Next.js — from your first layout to a team graduation project.

ux-ui.name: UX/UI Designer
ux-ui.description: Research, prototypes and interfaces in Figma. Design for websites and mobile apps.

python.name: Python Developer
python.description: Python, SQL, Django, FastAPI and Docker. Backend development, APIs and Telegram bots.

data-analyst.name: Data Analyst
data-analyst.description: Excel, SQL, Python, statistics and A/B tests, dashboards in DataLens and Power BI.

marketing.name: Digital Marketer
marketing.description: Strategy, Yandex Direct, paid social, SEO, SMM and web analytics with real budgets.

mentors.title: A mentor at every step
mentors.text: Practitioners review every assignment within 48 hours. Each mentor works with no more than 25 students.

projects.title: A portfolio of real tasks
projects.text: 4 to 6 projects per course, with a graduation project for a real client.

career.title: Help finding a job
career.text: CV reviews, mock interviews and referrals to partner companies. 78% of graduates find a job within 6 months.

flexible.title: Easy to combine with work
flexible.text: Webinars in the evening and recordings always at hand. You can pause and continue with the next cohort.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.text: Managers are available Monday to Friday, 10 am – 7 pm Moscow time. The assistant on this website answers 24/7.
